messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] Airflow Providers - release preparation date 2026-10-06
messages.body:
Hello,

Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-10-06 have been accepted.

3 "+1" binding votes received:
- Jarek Potiuk
- Vincent Beck
- Nikolas Oliveira

5 "+1" non-binding votes received:
- Pankaj Koti
- Subhramit B.B.
- Pankaj Singh
- Bingqin Wang
- David Blain

1 "+1" non-binding vote received for specific providers:
- Sameer Mesiah (amazon, snowflake)

The providers amazon, common.ai, dbt.cloud and google have been
excluded from the release.
This is due to bugs found while testing the release candidates: in
dbt.cloud and google, in
common.ai (SandboxToolset deep copy, #74525) and in amazon (IAM
Identity Center login, #74529).
The next RC candidates for those providers will be released as an
ad-hoc release on their own
with accelerated vote period.

Vote thread: https://lists.apache.org/thread/t58ppv8qkxncpyt1r6nwjx8lhbskv783

I'll continue with the release process, and the release announcement
will follow shortly.

Cheers,
Jarek Potiuk
